purpose: Search for legitimate mirrors, forks, backups, replacement public releases and independent reconstruction routes for the unavailable VASCO 107875-row candidate/ML-score lineage without inventing rows, bypassing redistribution restrictions, or confusing an independent reconstruction with the original closed cohort.

checks: global GitHub code search for exact former URLs
global GitHub code search for distinctive ML feature red_dist_to_edge_px
inspection of currently public repositories under dca-doherty
recovery_routes.finding: The GitHub account dca-doherty still exists and has other public repositories, so disappearance is repository-specific rather than account-wide. No surviving public fork/rename of either VASCO repository surfaced in this pass.
recovery_routes.next_use: Keep as a provenance watch route; a later public restoration or fork can be admitted only after commit/content verification.

recovery_routes.source: jannefi/poss1-plate-slice docs/PLATE_EDGE_MASK.md and Metabunk Aug 16 2026 discussion
recovery_routes.finding: Jari Sinkkonen states the formerly public Doherty VASCO-Replication repository is no longer accessible but that he has a local copy. His public technical documentation preserves details observed in that copy.
recovery_routes.scientific_value: The replication code could recover exact analysis mechanics and field/schema expectations even if the underlying 107875-row dataset remains restricted.
recovery_routes.legal_provenance_guard: A local copy should only be imported if the holder is permitted to share the code or if a provenance-verifiable archive of the formerly public code is found. The restricted source dataset is a separate object and must not be inferred to be redistributable merely because code was once public.

evidence: Doherty arXiv:2604.00056 states the original authors supplied the 107875-transient catalogue on request.
Jari Sinkkonen publicly stated on 2026-04-15 that he had obtained the full 107875-row MNRAS/VASCO list.
On 2026-04-29 he explicitly stated that he did not have permission to redistribute the unpublished 107K list.
recovery_routes.acceptable_path: Acquire from the original authors, an authorized public release, or another holder with explicit redistribution permission.

recovery_routes.finding: The repository references these local datasets, but the key XLSX was ignored from the earliest git history; no historical Git blob was recovered. Global exact-filename code search produced references rather than a public copy.
recovery_routes.role: Preserve file names as search fingerprints only.

recovery_routes.historical_finding: An initial audit link existed publicly in April 2026 and was later replaced by the final release.
useful_aggregate_findings: The third-party reference list has 107875 sources.
The public derived audit does not reproduce source coordinates, respecting redistribution limits.

recovery_routes.promise: After publication of the machine-learning paper, VASCO stated it planned to release the full catalog with date, time, sky position, and the ML-derived score/probability for each individual transient.
recovery_routes.result: No authoritative row-level post-publication catalog surfaced in this pass. The promise remains a high-priority legitimate acquisition route.

release_properties.claimed_detection_recall_against_publish: minimum approximately 96 percent, potentially up to approximately 98 percent; this is an upstream author's validation claim, not TOPA ground truth

recovery_routes.why_it_matters: It reconstructs the detection/candidate universe from public plate-addressed POSS-I scans without depending on unpublished VASCO coordinates, and it preserves empty tiles needed for observing-opportunity denominators.
limitations: It is not byte-identical to the closed 107875 VASCO list.
Its filtering and sky-coverage decisions differ from the unpublished VASCO pipeline.
It does not contain the authors' original ML ensemble scores.

recovery_routes.finding: JANUS already pins and hash-verifies the poss1-plate-slice 20260814 release, reconstructs tile-to-plate bindings, retrieves plate-addressed FITS header provenance, and does not accept unpublished VASCO files.
recovery_routes.role: Direct handoff into TOPA JSON rails is available without new candidate acquisition.

recovery_routes.explanation: The public release contains 122820 rows across 642 plates and 313 unique nights through 1957-12-19. The frozen scientific study window ends 1957-04-28, leaving 640 plates, 312 nights, and 122511 candidates. All 122820 release rows successfully map to a plate. The 309-row difference is outside-window data, not an undocumented deduplication or scientific selection.
recovery_routes.importance: Removes an internal provenance ambiguity before the next harmonized replay.

additional_public_reconstruction_state.note: This count follows SuperCOSMOS and PTF post-processing in the independent open pipeline. It is not treated as the canonical cohort for TOPA until the exact stage/configuration is frozen for the experiment.
additional_public_reconstruction_state.plate_edge_control: The open pipeline exposes plate-edge geometry as a measured field/instrument rather than silently cutting rows, allowing TOPA to preregister edge-aware sensitivity arms.

priority_order.action: Continue looking for the promised authorized VASCO post-publication catalog containing row-level date/time/position/ML scores.
Recover the formerly public VASCO-Replication code from a provenance-verifiable archive or authorized local copy; keep code and restricted data as separate acquisition objects.

Use poss1-plate-slice as the independent public candidate universe and train a TOPA artifact classifier from reproducible public pixels/labels, explicitly marked TOPA_RECONSTRUCTION rather than VASCO_ML_REPRODUCTION.
Run the frozen DOE/NV-209 Rev.16 calendar and actual tile/plate opportunity through the open cohort before any external ML-model absorption.
Compare aggregate VASCO60/Doherty diagnostics against TOPA reconstruction to identify plate-edge, center-definition, and observation-date incompatibilities before interpreting effect differences.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not scrape or republish a restricted 107875-row copy from an unauthorized cache merely because it once circulated privately.
Do not label poss1-plate-slice rows as the original VASCO closed cohort.
Do not reverse-engineer missing ML scores from published p-values or decile counts.
Do not treat a formerly public code repository as recovered until actual files/commits are obtained and provenance-checked.
Do not choose a post-processing stage because it produces a preferred nuclear-window effect.
Do not convert VASCO detection-recall claims into evidence for the nuclear association.
